title: Top Board Games for Family Game Night (2026)
summary: Ticket to Ride, Labyrinth, Catan, and Everdell stand out as the most frequently praised family board games of 2026, offering a mix of strategy, accessibility, and replayability.
method: Selected titles that appear in more than one trusted review site (Mumsnet, Independent, Runwild) and highlighted their best‑overall or best‑family designations.
assumptions: Prices are only included when a source lists them; otherwise the price field is null.
